From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finbridge.com>

Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Consolidate onboarding sessions for FinBridge

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the initial runbook and the two training slots you proposed. We're trying to reduce executive attendee juggling on our side and would prefer a single consolidated session that covers both the Console walkthrough and the API enablement.

High-level asks:
- Combine Console + API into a contiguous 4-hour block where possible (with a short break).
- Include a brief Q&A and an operations runbook handoff.
- Have Redwood cover key preflight checks (API keys, test workspace) at the start so our engineers can follow along.

Preferred window (all times in CEST):
- Option A: Tue 1 Jul 10:00–14:00 CET
- Option B: Wed 2 Jul 08:00–12:00 CET

Attendees: Priya Shah (Platform Ops), Markus Engstrom (CTO), plus two SREs (names attached).

I attached our desired agenda and attendee list to help with planning. Can you let me know whether you can consolidate, and who from Redwood will lead each segment?

Thanks,

--
Priya Shah
Head of Platform Operations
FinBridge

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Consolidate onboarding sessions for FinBridge

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the context and the agenda — happy to consolidate this into a single block. Proposed plan:

- 10:00–10:20: Introductions & preflight checks (Hannah)
- 10:20–11:30: Console walkthrough + hands-on (Tessa)
- 11:30–11:40: Break
- 11:40–13:10: API enablement deep-dive + live keys (Ben)
- 13:10–14:00: Runbook handoff & Q&A (Hannah + Ben)

Given your preferred windows, Option A (Tue 1 Jul 10:00–14:00 CET) works best for our lead engineers. If we need APAC-friendly timing, we can split into two shorter blocks but my preference is to keep it consolidated as you suggested.

Couple quick asks to make the session smooth:
- Please confirm the final attendee list and their timezones (we got a CSV but it's missing one SRE).
- Share any allowlisted IPs ahead of time if you want us to pre-configure.
- Confirm whether you want us to run an interactive sample inference during the API segment (usually takes ~15 minutes).

I've attached a small calendar-block .ics with the two candidate slots and cc'd Ben (will lead API) and Tessa (console lead). If Tue 1 Jul is confirmed I'll finalize and push a Drive folder with the lab creds and post-session notes.

Best,

Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Hannah / Tessa,

- I'll own API keys, live inference demo, and a short section on batching/quantization recommendations relevant to FinBridge's model sizes.
- Tessa, you should prepare the console login demo and a failover demo showing routing to the cheaper model variant (they flagged cost).

  - Test workspace populated with sample dataset (we should upload a tiny sample beforehand)
  - Metrics dashboard link + read-only viewer access for Markus & Priya

I'll draft the final lab creds doc after Hannah confirms the attendee list and preferred slot. If we need a backup window for APAC overlap, propose Wed 2 Jul 16:00–18:00 CET (shorter, hands-on light).
